Container.Name: factorio-server-manager
Container.Overview: Modernized Factorio Server Manager with named profiles, verified fixed save checkpoints, Factorio-rendered new-world previews, compatible-mod management, base Factorio/Space Age, and stable, experimental or pinned game versions. Manager data, profiles, checkpoints and the exact installed game version persist across container updates.
Container.Requires: /opt/fsm-data plus the three game-data paths for saves, mods and config must be mapped to persistent host storage. Internet access is required on first start so the selected Factorio headless release can be downloaded. The image supports linux/amd64.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to open the Factorio Server Manager web interface.

Config.Name: Factorio Game Port
Config.Description: UDP port used by Factorio clients to connect to the game server.

Config.Name: Manager Data (required)
Config.Description: Required persistent manager database, UI users/passwords, configuration, logs, credentials, mod packs, profile archives and fixed checkpoints. Never remove this mapping during an update.

Config.Name: Mods (required)
Config.Description: Persistent downloaded mods, built-in game-mode selection and mod-list.json.

Config.Name: Config (required)
Config.Description: Persistent Factorio server and map configuration.

Config.Name: Initial Factorio Version Target
Config.Description: Used only for the first installation: latest, stable or an exact version such as 2.1.14. Later UI choices are persisted and override this value during container updates.

Config.Name: RCON Password
Config.Description: Optional internal Factorio RCON password. Leave empty to generate and persist a random password automatically.
